name: Saucy Baked Chicken Enchiladas with Beans and Corn

components.name: Chicken Enchiladas
steps: Mix paprika, cumin, oregano, garlic and onion powder, salt and pepper. Set a small portion aside for sauce.
In a saucepan, whisk olive oil and flour briefly, stir in passata and stock, then add reserved seasoning; simmer until the sauce coats a spoon.
Toss raw chicken with the remaining spice mix and sear in olive oil until browned and at least 74 C; rest and dice.
Soften onion, garlic and bell pepper in the same pan. Fold in chicken, beans, corn and 60 ml water; cook until thick but moist.
Heat oven to 180 C. Fill eight tortillas evenly with chicken mixture and a little grated cheese. Roll and arrange in a baking dish over a little sauce.
Cover with remaining sauce and cheese, bake about 20 minutes until bubbling and completely hot.
Cool in shallow portions; freeze whole enchiladas in sauce for future meals.
